_comment: Mock DataHub lineage response used when BLAST_MOCK_DATAHUB=1. Mirrors the shape datahub_client.py expects back from the real lineage query plus each node's viewProperties.logic aspect.

downstream.name: int_orders_enriched
downstream.view_logic:
select
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.order_status,
    o.order_total,
    o.order_total_tax,
    o.order_date,
    c.customer_name
from stg_orders o
left join stg_customers c
    on o.customer_id = c.customer_id

downstream.name: fct_orders
downstream.view_logic:
select
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    order_status,
    order_date
from stg_orders

downstream.name: rpt_revenue
downstream.view_logic:
select
    date_trunc('month', order_date) as revenue_month,
    sum(order_total_tax) as total_tax_collected
from stg_orders
group by 1

downstream.name: rpt_daily_order_value
downstream.view_logic:
select
    order_date,
    sum(order_total) as daily_order_value
from int_orders_enriched
group by 1

downstream.name: rpt_customer_activity
downstream.view_logic:
select
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    count(order_id) as order_count,
    max(order_date) as last_order_date
from int_orders_enriched
group by 1, 2
